description: This file defines an Android activity class BackupRestoreActivity that demonstrates various backup and restore mechanisms using Android's BackupAgent API. The class manages UI interactions, persistent data storage, and backup requests related to backup and restore processes.

classes.name: BackupRestoreActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating backup and restore practices, UI controls for user interaction, and file management system for persisting data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity UI components, prepares file and backup manager references, and populates UI based on persisted data.

methods.name: populateUI
methods.description: Reads persistent data file to restore UI state, creating default data and requesting backup if data file doesn't exist.

methods.name: writeDataToFileLocked
methods.description: Writes the current UI state data (mayo, tomato, filling type) to the data file.

methods.name: recordNewUIState
methods.description: Updates persistent data file with current UI selections and signals backup manager for data backup.

methods.name: onRestoreButtonClick
methods.description: Handles restore button click to initiate a restore process via BackupManager.
